summary: Family-friendly childcare website with three key experiences: an interactive “Clubhouse” home page, a vibrant secure Parent Portal dashboard centered on a fun-framed nanny cam and quick status icons, and a low-pressure Tours & Interviews booking page with playful logo-derived decorative elements.
architectural_notes: Site information architecture centers on three primary pages/experiences: Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, Tours & Interviews Booking
Parent Portal requires authenticated/secure access distinct from public pages
Parent Portal UI prioritizes at-a-glance status indicators (Nap/Snack/Play) and a prominent nanny cam embed
Brand styling uses rounded bubble containers and logo-derived accents (stars/butterflies) as decorative motifs
Primary CTA language on home page is “Join the Club” (instead of “Book Now”)
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Sunny park hero illustration with soft warm lighting, playful shapes, and space for foreground UI (clubhouse-hero-sunny-park.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of playful star sticker illustrations (varied sizes, warm colors) (stickers-stars-set.dim_1024x1024.png)
- Set of playful butterfly sticker illustrations (varied sizes, warm colors) (stickers-butterflies-set.dim_1024x1024.png)
- Fun rounded “frame” border graphic suitable for wrapping a video/feed area (nanny-cam-fun-frame.dim_1200x800.png)
- Set of quick-glance icons in a consistent bubbly style: nap, snack, play (status-icons-nap-snack-play.dim_768x256.png)
- Portrait-style photo/illustration placeholder of “Auntie Maia” in a warm friendly style (meet-auntie-maia-portrait.dim_800x800.png)

existing_features.title: Create a cohesive, playful visual theme across the app that matches a family-friendly “interactive digital playground” brand: rounded bubble-like containers, warm sunny palette (avoid blue/purple as the primary scheme), playful star/butterfly accents, and consistent typography and spacing.
Implement the “Clubhouse” Home page with a sunny-park hero section and a prominent, giant “Join the Club” call-to-action button as the primary interaction.
Create navigation/routing so users can reach the three experiences: Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking page from the UI.

Implement the “Parent Portal” Dashboard with a secure “VIP Lounge” feel, featuring a nanny cam feed/video area as the centerpiece with a playful, non-clinical frame/border, plus quick-glance status widgets/icons for “Nap”, “Snack”, and “Play”.

Add a minimal access-control flow for the Parent Portal so it feels “secure”: require Internet Identity sign-in before viewing the dashboard, and show a friendly sign-in screen/state when not authenticated.

Implement the “Tours & Interviews” Booking page with a low-pressure, exciting feel: include a booking calendar UI and a “Meet Auntie Maia” photo/video area placed next to the calendar, with star/butterfly sticker-style decorations around the calendar region.
Add backend support for creating and listing booking requests from the Tours & Interviews page (e.g., select date/time and submit), and display a confirmation state in the UI after submission.
Place generated image assets in the frontend as static files and render them on the appropriate pages (hero image on Home; stickers and frames on Parent Portal and Booking page).

new_feature_requests.summary: Design and build “Clubhouse” home page with interactive playful vibe (bubble containers, star accents, sunny park hero) and prominent “Join the Club” CTA
Create “Parent Portal” dashboard with secure VIP feel, nanny cam as centerpiece with fun border, and quick-glance status icons (Nap/Snack/Play)
Create “Tours & Interviews” booking page with calendar scheduling, “Meet Auntie Maia” video/photo area, and logo sticker-style butterflies/stars around calendar

projectName: Build Clubhouse Home, Parent Portal Dashboard, and Tours & Interviews Booking Pages
